Median 9 pieces per locality over 68 localities (median 2.94 km2, 4 hexes). sources/mt_geo.py cuts Kontur hexes to the localities and shares each hex's people by area, so every locality has 2 or more pieces where a centroid join left 4 with none. Weighed against uniform placement with the bar set before reading (keep if p10 >= 0.6 and p90 <= 1.6): per-locality Kontur/census p10 0.66, median 1.02, p90 1.45, Spearman 0.94 (sources/mt.md §5)

Median 6 populated hexes per atoll over 3 atolls (17 hexes). Weighed against uniform placement: 7 of the 17 hexes hold 1 to 4 people (16 in all) and the other 10 are the four villages, so equal shares would put 1 dot in 5 on Fakaofo and 1 in 2 on Atafu and Nukunonu on a near-empty hex, and the atoll units are 2,000 to 2,700 km2 of sea and reef. Kontur per atoll is 1.38x to 1.66x the 2016 residents present (sources/tk_geo.py, sources/tk.md §5)
